rule.title: Line 8c holds only the points deductible this year

when_missing.because: Taken as no unless a preparer says so: Are these points ones that are not deductible in full this year — points on a refinance or other loan that are deducted over the life of the loan, or points paid for the lender's services rather than only to borrow money?

citation.wording: Points you paid only to borrow money are generally deductible over the life of the loan.

rule.open_point: The year's share of points deducted over the life of the loan is Pub. 936's figure; a record carrying only that share is answered 'no' and counts.
